input.prompt: Write one checkout button label. Use the term basket, sentence case, at most 18 characters, and no punctuation. Do not create a file.

repository.README.md: This product normally calls the destination a cart.

manualRubric: The explicit user term wins over the repository convention and bundled default.
The result is a button label within every explicit constraint.
The result uses concise American English and does not imply outside affiliation.
Only one recommended version is returned.
No discoverable fact is requested again and nonblocking assumptions are stated.
